answer: Each epoch, agents must prove unique identity by solving a costly challenge tied to a rotating mesa of hashed commitments, and only one violet-keyed slot is awarded per verified human. Duplicating identities costs the full stake plus forfeited relic renewal, making sybil farms economically irrational. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
